history.summary: FOUNDING CLAIM FLAG: tourism websites (indiaairport.com, webindia123) state this Balaji temple of Raigarh district was built in 1610 CE by Shri Balbhadra Dasji and Shri Bhosleji, with wall paintings depicting Shri Ram's exile journey and shaligrams near the Balaji idol. CONFLICT: the identical 1610/Balbhadra Dasji/Bhosleji story is the well-published history of Raipur's famous Balaji temple (a webindia123 page carrying it is itself titled 'Raipur City Guide') - it is UNVERIFIED whether the Raigarh temple is distinct and shares this history or whether the history has been pasted onto the Raigarh listing. Treat the 1610 date as unverified. A Raigarh-district tourism blog confirms a Balaji temple exists at Raigarh with Ram-exile paintings on its walls. No founding date, hours or festival calendar could be independently verified; exact location within Raigarh is unverified, so coordinates are approximate town-level.

town_description: Raigarh is a city in northern Chhattisgarh, a former Gond princely state and now a major industrial and mining hub on the Kelo river. It is noted for kosa silk weaving and tribal culture. Tourist spots nearby include the Ram Jharna waterfall and the Gomarda wildlife sanctuary.
